Detailed Description

This class holds radar configuration parameters, which can be set by the user.

Member Data Documentation

◆ frameTriggerDelay

uint16_t hrvs_sdk::RadarConfig::frameTriggerDelay = DEFAULT_FRAME_TRIGGER_DELAY

Frame Trigger Delay in microseconds. radar #1 is configured with: framTriggerDelay * 1, radar #2 is configured with: framTriggerDelay * 2, radar #3 is configured with: framTriggerDelay * 3, radar #4 is configured with: framTriggerDelay * 4

◆ radarType

RadarType hrvs_sdk::RadarConfig::radarType = DEFAULT_RADAR_TYPE

Type of radar (used to determine the protocol version).

◆ rangeFilterEnable

bool hrvs_sdk::RadarConfig::rangeFilterEnable = DEFAULT_RANGE_FILTER_ENABLE

Enables filtering of measurements by measured range. Significantly improves performance of EAP model in ground applications. Value of parameter ignored in protocol 1.0.

◆ rangeFilterMax

float hrvs_sdk::RadarConfig::rangeFilterMax = DEFAULT_RANGE_FILTER_MAX

Maximal range of measurement in meters. Values above this range are filtered out. Parameter rangeFilterEnable must be true for this parameter to be used. Value of parameter ignored in protocol 1.0.

◆ rangeFilterMin

float hrvs_sdk::RadarConfig::rangeFilterMin = DEFAULT_RANGE_FILTER_MIN

Minimal range of measurement in meters. Values below this range are filtered out. Parameter rangeFilterEnable must be true for this parameter to be used. Value of parameter ignored in protocol 1.0.
